description: This file defines classes and constants for managing WebKit protocol connections and sessions within the Playwright testing framework, including message dispatching, connection handling, and session lifecycle management.

classes.name: WKConnection
classes.description: Manages WebKit protocol connection, message dispatching, and disconnection handling.

classes.name: WKSession
classes.description: Represents a WebKit protocol session, handling message sending, callbacks, and lifecycle.

methods.name: nextMessageId
methods.description: Generates a new unique message ID.

methods.name: rawSend
methods.description: Sends a protocol message through the transport.

methods.name: _dispatchMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, dispatching to the appropriate session or ignoring close messages.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles connection closure, logs, and cleanup.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns whether the connection is closed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection if not already closed.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command message and returns a promise for the response.

methods.name: sendMayFail
methods.description: Sends a command message, logs errors, and may return void if failed.

methods.name: isDisposed
methods.description: Checks if the session is disposed.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the session, rejecting all pending callbacks.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages to callbacks or emits events.
